hero.title: Build your next app on solid ground

features.title: Everything you need to start
features.description: Each piece is small, replaceable and documented.

backend.title: FastAPI backend
backend.description: Typed Python API with uv, tests and coverage out of the box.

frontend.title: React frontend
frontend.description: Vite, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components you own and can edit.

auth.title: Secure login
auth.description: A backend-for-frontend with any OpenID Connect provider: tokens never reach the browser.

releases.title: Releases per service
releases.description: One changelog and one version for each service, plus a global release.

i18n.title: Multilingual
i18n.description: English and French included, one JSON file per language.

containers.title: Containers
containers.description: Docker images built, scanned and published on every release.

annotation.intro: Anyone who can access this dataset can annotate it.
annotation.newHint: Create an annotation task. Everyone with access to the dataset will be able to take part.
annotation.name: Name
annotation.labelsHint: At least 2 labels, each with a different name.
annotation.selectWords: Select text with the mouse (or click a word, shift + click to extend), then pick one or more labels. Passages may overlap.
annotation.pickLabel: Choose an entity type (or press its number).

classification.title: Classification
classification.hint: Give one label to each text.

ner.title: Entity extraction
ner.hint: Highlight the people, places, etc. in the text.

qa.title: Question answering
qa.hint: Write several question-answer pairs per text and highlight their source.

row_label.title: Row labelling
row_label.hint: Give a label to each row (normal, suspect, duplicate…).

cell_review.title: Cell review
cell_review.hint: Flag a wrong or missing value and give the right one.

column_schema.title: Column schema
column_schema.hint: Describe each column: role, type, format and unit.

regression.title: Regression
regression.hint: Give a number to each text or row: a score, a rating, a price…

annotation.labelDescription: Description: when to use this label
annotation.editLabelsHint: Renaming or describing a label updates it everywhere. Deleting a label keeps existing annotations but they will show as “deleted label”.
annotation.reasonPlaceholder: Explain your choice (a word, a quote, a rule…)

entity.title: Entity
entity.hint: A unit: a name, a first name, a date, a place…

semantic.title: Semantic
semantic.hint: A business meaning, often a longer passage: an offence, a sentence…

annotation.formatOther: Format, e.g. DDDDDDD (D digit, A letter, X both)
annotation.formatHelp: One or more. D = digit, A = letter, X = letter or digit, + = one or more. Press Enter to add.
annotation.formatHelpDate: One or more. YYYY year, MM month, DD day, HH hour, mm minute, ss second. Press Enter to add.
annotation.labelDialogHint: Describe the label so that every annotator understands when to use it.
annotation.labelDuplicate: Another label already has this name.

qa.pick: Choose what this passage is for the active question (keys 1 and 2).
qa.hint: Write a question, then select text and highlight its source. Add as many questions as you need for the same text.
qa.question: Question
qa.answerPlaceholder: Answer: type it, or select it in the text

tab.hintRow: Click a row, choose a label. Arrow keys move, 1-9 pick a label.
tab.hintCell: Click a cell and say what is wrong with it. Arrow keys move, 1-9 pick an issue.
tab.hintColumn: Click a column header and describe it. Arrow keys move, 1-9 pick a role.
tab.pickRow: Select a row to annotate it.
tab.pickCell: Select a cell to annotate it.
tab.pickColumn: Select a column to describe it.
tab.hintValue: Click a row and give it a value on the scale. Arrow keys move.

scale.invalid: The minimum must be lower than the maximum, and the step positive.
